item.description:
Faces shareholder suits over NextEra merger; vote Sept 3

Received demand letters and two shareholder complaints alleging disclosure deficiencies in the definitive proxy statement for its merger with NextEra Energy. The company voluntarily issued supplemental disclosures and denies the allegations. A special shareholder meeting to vote on the merger is scheduled for September 3, 2026.

About: Dominion Energy, Inc. provides regulated electricity and natural gas services in the United States. It operates through Dominion Energy Virginia, Dominion Energy South Carolina, and Contracted Energy segments. The Dominion Energy Virginia segment engages in the generation, distribution, and transmission of electricity to approximately 2.8 million residential, commercial, industrial, and governmental customers in Virginia and North Carolina.

item.scanner:headline: Reiterates unsolicited bid; Aurora shares -35% vs Curaleaf +56%
item.description:
Reiterates unsolicited bid; Aurora shares -35% vs Curaleaf +56%

Curaleaf reiterates its unsolicited offer for Aurora Cannabis, rejecting Aurora's characterization of discussions. Curaleaf notes Aurora's shares declined ~35% over the past year while Curaleaf's rose ~56%, and cites Aurora's guidance for lower revenue and margins in FY2027. Curaleaf remains willing to meet anytime to discuss a deal.

About: Curaleaf Holdings, Inc. engages in the retail and wholesale of cannabis products in the United States and internationally. The company operates licensed cultivation; and pharma-grade cannabis processing and manufacturing facilities. It also supplies cannabis on a wholesale basis to Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom and various European countries, including Germany, Italy, Poland, the Czech Republic, Switzerland, Sweden and Norway.

  • Counterparty: Aurora Cannabis
  • Next catalyst: Aurora's response to offer
